class: read-only engineering observation over already-written artifacts; not a scientific result and not a review verdict

normalization: timing fields dropped (seconds, elapsed, ...); UUID-valued strings replaced by a placeholder (aircraft ids are not seed-derived); UUIDs embedded inside free-text 'detail' strings were NOT normalized

difference_classes: ego UUIDs inside construction / eligibility 'detail' text (id generation, not seed-derived)

interpretation_boundary: The actor weights at update 0 are proven identical (preflight.json actor_initialization_identity_check). The +/-1-tick differences reproduce between the historical actor-only and CTDE pair at one code SHA, so they are a pre-existing process-level execution nondeterminism (plausibly hash- or id-ordered iteration interacting with the recorded BLADE live-list removal behaviour), NOT a CTDE-introduced confound. The cause is not established here; it is recorded for the run review and must be considered when interpreting per-episode (not aggregate) cross-arm comparisons.
